gusl._comment_perlevel: Per-level params listed deepest_level → level 1. Single scalar broadcasts to all levels.
gusl._comment_pyramid: Pyramid depth — number of coarse-to-fine levels trained.
gusl._comment_saab: Saab PCA patch window: spatial (kernel_size) and Z (kernel_depth) extent of each filter.
gusl._comment_neigh: Neighborhood aggregation around each pixel: window size/depth; stride downsamples spatial context.
gusl._comment_grad: Gradient features: toggle on/off per level; size/depth = Sobel window extent.
gusl._comment_rft: DualRFT feature selection: batch_centers = pixels sampled for Saab fit; n_bins = histogram buckets; n_selected = features kept; rft_sample_frac = fraction of pixels used to fit RFT (null/1.0 = all, 0.3-0.5 is usually sufficient).
gusl._comment_lnt: LNT leaf-node linear transform: depth/num_tree control the XGBoost sub-tree used to partition leaves; lnt_sample_frac = fraction of pixels used for LDA/linear fit (null/1.0 = all, 0.3-0.5 sufficient).
gusl._comment_xgb: XGBoost final regressor: n_estimators = tree count; max_depth = tree depth (complexity vs overfitting); learning_rate = step size; early_stopping_rounds = halt when val loss stalls.

train._comment_patch: training_patch_size = [D, H, W]. base_size is auto-derived from H.

gusl._comment_selection: Sample selection: keep_frac = fraction of pixels kept after thinning; low/high thresholds define boundary band for pos/neg sampling.
gusl._comment_percentage: Per-level fraction of data used for encode (FeatGen/RFT) and decode (XGBoost) training. Must match deepest_level length.

inference._comment_patch: z_chunk_depth = Z frames loaded at once (bounds RAM for IO). inference_pixel_batch = pixels per predict batch; increase for speed, decrease if OOM.

output._comment_threshold: null = soft [0,255] output; number = binary mask (pixels >= threshold → 255, else 0).
